text:
maria.partnerships: Quick vendor recap: H200 will roll regionally (EMEA first), B200 availability earlier than expected in partner clouds, MI300 delayed ~3w, Gaudi needs a tiny runtime ABI patch. Need to decide marketplace exposure, SI test windows, and announcement waves. Propose two waves so MI300 doesn't hold everything.

lee.eng: Two-wave plan makes sense. For Gaudi ABI patch we should publish a '-gaudi-patch' CI image tag and freeze that image for SI testing. Need vendor kernel diff to validate.

owen.prod: Proposal: Wave 1 = H200 + B200 + Gaudi (early-access -> partner-visible -> public). Wave 2 = MI300. Wave 1 soft-listing 48h after partner signoff, public listing after marketing go/no-go.

tara.marketing: OK. Requirements: 72h for SI co-marketing assets, 48h for marketplace copy, and final quote approval 24h before public listing. Need contact for partner quote collection.

vikram.si: SI needs a validated AMI/container image, a perf harness, and a driver compatibility matrix. Can we standardize image tags and provide a test-runner repo? That reduces surprises.

cheng.hw-ops: Draft SKU naming pattern: <vendor>-<model>-<mem>-<region>. Example: nvidia-h200-48g-usw2, nvidia-b200-80g-use1, samba-gaudi-v2-euc1, amd-mi300-128g-usw2. We'll publish firmware/BIOS versions once vendors lock them.

lee.eng: Rollout canary suggestion: 10% traffic to new SKU for 3-4h, monitor errors and 99th pct latency, then ramp. Also pre-deploy runtime patch to canary nodes only.

owen.prod: Need a rollback checklist: marketplace toggle, routing revert, SI partner notification template. Who owns the runbook update?

maria.partnerships: I'll update runbook and share. Action owners: 1) cheng: finalize SKU map + firmware table by Tue EOD. 2) lee: publish GAUDI patch image + CI baseline by Mon. 3) vikram: confirm SI image/test requirements by Tue. 4) tara: assemble embargo schedule and asset checklist by Tue noon.

ops-bot: Calendar hold created: "Vendor Marketplace Launch - Wave 1" Wed 10am PT (30m).

tara.marketing: I'll create a shared folder for press assets and a checklist. Please drop partner quotes 72h prior or we delay public listing.

vikram.si: Will request vendor test hardware access. Partnerships, can you request trial units?

maria.partnerships: Requesting trial units now and pinging vendor PMs for H200 regional table. If no objections, we'll run with the two-wave plan and confirm in Wed sync. :white_check_mark:
